prefs_lead: Personal choices, kept in your JGates data folder. They change neither the project nor what is approved.
prefs_theme_note: System follows the theme of your operating system.
prefs_language_note: The language applies to the interface text and to the messages of the local server. Changing it reloads the page.
prefs_more: What is not a personal preference
prefs_network_note: Network access is a run policy of the repository: it is edited in Configuration and shows up in the plan review. Run retention belongs to your data folder and lives in Storage.
prefs_providers_note: The AI providers of the semantic gate, the connections to a gateway and the API keys live outside the project, in the user's key store. The screen saves and changes a key, but never shows the stored value.
